title: AI-Assisted Requirements Prioritization: Spotify Playlist Case Study
shortDescription: Explore a hands-on Spotify-style playlist simulator, inspect real Spotify API documentation, use ChatGPT or Gemini for a proposed release, and verify the decision with Python.
learningOutcomes: Read and cite real Spotify Web API requirements using linked official D1-D4 documentation.
Test playlist actions in a local simulator and identify invalid public/collaborative configurations.
Use weighted stakeholder ratings and budget constraints to select a feasible software release.
Evaluate an external generative AI recommendation against official API rules and independently verified Python results.

courseAlignment.evidence: Students analyze official API requirements, sources, limitations, and LLM-generated suggestions.
Students implement an API policy constraint, apply utility analysis, and justify a bounded release.
Students interpret ranked utilities, optimization outputs, budget sensitivity, and AI-versus-human disagreements.

tasks.title: Explore the Spotify case and official documentation
tasks.description: Open Spotify Case, explore the playlist, and inspect D1-D4 evidence. Record two documented API constraints.

tasks.title: Interact with playlist actions and reproduce FR-06
tasks.description: Rename the playlist, add and remove sample tracks, and test invalid public + collaborative settings.

tasks.title: Run the flawed release baseline
tasks.description: Run main.py, then view the selected features and policy status in Spotify Case.

tasks.title: Fix the Spotify playlist rule
tasks.description: Implement playlist_policy_ok(public, collaborative) and retest FR-06.

tasks.title: Compute stakeholder-weighted utility
tasks.description: Correct requirement_utility(row), run Python, and inspect the 8-day release in Spotify Case.

tasks.title: Use ChatGPT or Gemini as a requirements reviewer
tasks.description: In Spotify Case, copy the grounded prompt, open an external AI assistant, and record its source-backed recommendation.

tasks.title: Audit the AI ranking and budget
tasks.description: Paste the AI's ranked IDs into main.py, try the 6-day budget, restore 8 days, and Verify Requirements.

tasks.title: Submit the case-study report
tasks.description: Summarize evidence, observed behavior, corrected Python, AI recommendation, constraints and test results.
